meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub 的 PR 和 Issue 评论同步为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天中跟进 GitHub 上的代码审查和问题讨论
copy.tagline_en: Sync GitHub PR and issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to follow GitHub code reviews and issue discussions in chat

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 GitHub 机器人账号，在指定仓库的 PR 和 Issue 评论中，被 @ 时自动回复，并持续跟进后续评论。
howto.when: 当用户在 PR 或 Issue 评论中 @ 机器人账号时触发；首次 @ 后，该线程被订阅，后续所有评论都会自动回复。

say.text: 帮我回复这个 PR 的评论：@my-org-bot 这个方案可行吗？
say.note: Claude 会以机器人账号身份回复该评论。

say.text: 在 Issue #42 中 @my-org-bot 询问下一步计划。
say.note: Claude 会进入该 Issue 的对话线程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically reply when @-mentioned in PR and issue comment threads on specified repos, and continue responding to follow-up comments in subscribed threads.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user @-mentions the bot account in a PR or issue comment. After the first mention, the thread is subscribed and all subsequent comments trigger a response.

say_en.text: Reply to this PR comment: @my-org-bot Is this approach feasible?
say_en.note: Claude will reply as the bot account.

say_en.text: In Issue #42, @my-org-bot ask about next steps.
say_en.note: Claude will join that issue's conversation thread.
